label: shiftDropped: Photo's Shift never reaches EditModifiers, so a corner drag loses its aspect and a turn its snap
optionDropped: Photo's Option never reaches EditModifiers, so a drag no longer mirrors about the centre
toleranceFixed: the handle hit ignores the caller's tolerance and always uses 6
axesSwapped: a canvas point reaches the kernel with x and y swapped
find: TransformRules.local(Point(x: p.x, y: p.y), in: kernel)
replace: TransformRules.local(Point(x: p.y, y: p.x), in: kernel)

label: snapSkipped: a rotate drag adds the turn without BoxMath.snappedDegrees
